build_periodic_checkpointer: build a PeriodicCheckpointerWithCleanup for a PyTorch model with configurable save period and max checkpoints to keep
resume_or_load_checkpoint: resume training from the last checkpoint or load a checkpoint from a given file path
save_best_model: save the best model checkpoint as model_best.pth using PeriodicCheckpointerWithCleanup save_best method
step_checkpointer: advance the periodic checkpointer by one iteration and optionally clean up old checkpoints
load_checkpoint_from_path: load a checkpoint from a specific path into the checkpointer with optional checkpointables
